notes: Users can now pick a font family (Inter / Playfair Display / Cabin) and toggle Bold per text field, in most templates by default. While building this, found and fixed a real pre-existing bug: the bundled "Bold" font files were byte-for-byte identical copies of the Regular ones since the app's very first release, so Bold text has never actually rendered bold anywhere in the app until now. Regenerated genuine bold weights from the bundled variable fonts' own weight axis.
